title: How many of the microloans in a pool an Odisha NBFC-MFI offers a bank, every loan current at the 31 December 2026 cut-off ten weeks after a cyclone, will be 90 or more days past due on 30 June 2027
subdomain: credit-scoring-pd-modeling (six-month default of joint-liability group microloans in a direct-assignment pool)
prompt_shape: one forecast count to the nearest 100 loans; for each of the fourteen branches the pool borrowers in breach of the bank's microfinance guardrails on the bureau and the pool principal outstanding on their loans in INR lakh; a purchase note with one chart

distractors.why_relevant: deaths close members' loans through the credit-life cover, which looks like it should come off a default forecast or out of the pool
distractors.why_unused: the pool tape holds live borrowers' current loans at the cut-off; a claim settles a loan that is no longer in the pool, and no figure reads the register
distractors.ruled_out_by: the term sheet's clause 3 (the pool is the pool tape)

distractors.why_relevant: field officer coverage and moves look like a driver of collections in the cyclone months
distractors.why_unused: no figure reads a field officer; the forecast reads each group's own meetings
distractors.ruled_out_by: the ledger, which records every instalment at the meeting it fell due

distractors.why_relevant: the assignor's own PAR and collection efficiency by branch and month, which look like the pool's track record
distractors.why_unused: branch-level metrics cannot show which loans are current because co-members paid for them; the forecast reads the ledger at the group and meeting
distractors.ruled_out_by: the operating policy's section 6 (collection efficiency counts every instalment collected at the meeting) and the ledger's GRP_SUPP and GS rows

sources.origin: constructed for this task by task177/generator/build.py (seeded, deterministic) around a fictional NBFC-MFI (Prachi Valley Microfinance Pvt Ltd), a fictional bank (Tamralipta Bank Ltd), fictional lenders on a fictional credit bureau's report and a fictional October 2026 cyclone, set in real Odisha districts and blocks; villages and gram panchayats are invented names. Members are identified by number only. No real organisation's records or person is depicted.

files.covers: the loans offered in Pool PVM/2026-12 at the cut-off, one row per loan
every instalment due at a centre meeting from April 2025 to the cut-off, as Kshetra recorded it
every instalment due at a centre meeting, July 2023 to March 2024, as CollectPro exported it
every instalment due at a centre meeting, April 2024 to March 2025, as CollectPro exported it
CollectPro identifiers of members, loans and groups and their Kshetra identifiers from 1 April 2025
KYC of the pool's borrowers: bureau reference, enrolment date, village, gram panchayat and block as recorded at enrolment
the assignor's centres: codes on both platforms, branch, village, meeting day, field officer
the credit bureau's portfolio review of the pool's borrowers at the cut-off, one row per account
the bureau's member directory for the lenders in the review
the assignor's JLG operating policy, version 6.1
the bank's indicative term sheet for the pool
the bank's credit policy note on microfinance guardrails
the assignor's field update to lenders after the October 2026 cyclone
the assignor's monthly branch portfolio report, April 2024 to December 2026
credit-life claims on members' deaths, 2023 to 2026
